definitions.gloss: accrued payable; amount not yet paid
definitions.explanation: Money owed for something already received but outside the company's ordinary trade purchases — equipment, advertising, professional fees. Distinguished in bookkeeping from {買掛金|かいかけきん}.

examples.japanese: {未払金|みばらいきん}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: There is an unpaid amount outstanding.

examples.japanese: {広告費|こうこくひ}は{未払金|みばらいきん}として{計上|けいじょう}した。
examples.english: We recorded the advertising costs as an accrued payable.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}を{分割|ぶんかつ}で{購入|こうにゅう}したため、{未払金|みばらいきん}が{来年|らいねん}まで{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: We bought the machine in installments, so the payable continues into next year.

examples.japanese: {決算|けっさん}の{前|まえ}に、{未払金|みばらいきん}と{買掛金|かいかけきん}をきちんと{分|わ}けて{整理|せいり}しておく。
examples.english: Before closing the books, we sort out accrued payables and trade payables properly.

notes:
Formed from {未|み} (not yet) + {払|はら}い (payment) + {金|きん} (money). Outside accounting it is also used loosely for any bill still unpaid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未払金|みばらいきん}を{計上|けいじょう}する: to record an accrued payable
- {未払金|みばらいきん}が{残|のこ}る: for an unpaid amount to remain
- {未払金|みばらいきん}を{清算|せいさん}する: to settle an unpaid amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買掛金|かいかけきん}: accounts payable — used only for ordinary purchases of goods
- {未収金|みしゅうきん}: accrued receivable — the mirror image, money still to be received
- {未払|みばらい}い: unpaid — the adjectival form, as in {未払|みばらい}いの{家賃|やちん}
